title: Sheafification does not change stalks (presheaves of sets on a space)
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $x\in X$, and $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of sets on $X$ (on the site of open subsets of $X$ with open coverings), with sheafification $\theta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ in sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal Q$ on $X$ let $\mathcal Q_x=\varinjlim_{W\ni x}\mathcal Q(W)$ be its stalk, the colimit of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] over the open neighbourhoods $W$ of $x$ ordered by reverse inclusion, with germs $s\mapsto s_x$ (the coprojections). Then there is exactly one map of sets $\theta_x:\mathcal P_x\to\mathcal P^\#_x$ with $\theta_x(s_x)=(\theta_W(s))_x$ for every open $W\ni x$ and every $s\in\mathcal P(W)$, and $\theta_x$ is bijective.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma Tag 007Z (label lemma-stalk-sheafification, line 1563): $\mathcal F_x=\mathcal F^\#_x$ for a presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$; stalks as in Section Tag 0078 (section-stalks)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take C = Type v for X : TopCat.{v} (Type v has colimits and a terminal object; HasWeakSheafify from the instance HasSheafify J (Type (max u v)), Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/LeftExact.lean:313). Sheafify.lean:137 says (stalkFunctor (Type v) x).map (toSheafify J P) is an isomorphism; toSheafify is the unit of the sheafification adjunction, i.e. theta (any sheafification in the sense of the universal property is uniquely isomorphic to it compatibly with theta); by stalkFunctor_map_germ (Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Stalks.lean:147) this stalk map sends the germ of s to the germ of theta_W(s), and it is the only such map by stalk_hom_ext (Stalks.lean:140); an isomorphism in Type is a bijection by CategoryTheory.isIso_iff_bijective (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Types/Basic.lean:466). The abelian and ring versions are lem-weil-pbc-stalk-sheafification-space and lem-weil-pbc-ring-stalk-sheafification-space (same declaration).
